visual_synopsis: A mock TV report shot in autumn: an eccentric correspondent in a grey wig, glasses, goatee and rust-brown jacket delivers pieces to camera under yellowing trees and on a cracked asphalt lot, intercut with his interviewees - a heavy-set man in dark sunglasses and a black suit talking from the back seat of a car, and a smiling woman in a red coat and polka-dot headscarf leaning on a car roof. Between them the report cuts to a man in grey picking through a roadside rubbish dump by a brick wall, plus a brief white-limbo bumper of another character in a grey blazer and orange tie.
